name: 3S Viking Kingdom
author: Joakim
description: The dynasty half of the Viking split - content the old status panel never showed, fed by the Guild.Roster / Guild.Kingdom / Guild.War GMCP packages (3Scapes only). Tabs: Hird (the roster grid - level, age, atk/def, loyalty, status, champions, the bond matrix), Recruit (what each post wants in a hire, hiring hall, training, spymaster, varangians), Thralls (per-building counts + the follower), Grudges (per-town raid cooldowns, soonest first - the other half of auto-raid's targeting; 'vgrudge' prints it), Kingdom (lineage standings, trade reputation progress, diplomacy), Dynasty (house, spouse, children, schooling, heir), War (army, campaign, prison, the war ledger - the battle BOARD waits for a real war's payloads, which the capture never carried).
